groups.why_chosen: SNIC's extra internal PCIe switch adds a second PCIe hop that READ must cross twice round-trip, while WRITE saves one hop by completing at the switch instead of returning all the way to the RNIC core.
groups.what_to_learn: Two tiny swimlanes where the only difference is one extra lane; count the crossings, no colour needed
